span.p: Cosmetic

span.p: Clarifying or compatible

span.p: Breaking

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
SQLite is the source of truth. Markdown and Mermaid are views
An edit of a view is a proposal. It is never applied in place
Only the coordinator writes. Agents send typed requests
Coding stays parallel. Recording a result is the serialized part
Each record has a version. Each change set has a global revision
Freshness uses the read set, never the global number

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Who changed a view?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Watcher on .harness/views, debounced
A temp-file save counts as one edit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hash scan against the export manifest
at start, on open, and every 10 minutes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Diff of views between two state-branch commits

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Parse sections by markers: record ID, version, hash
Unchanged hash: skip. Fields diff exactly. Prose diffs as text
Links and ef-fields compared with stored edges
Text outside a marker: doc-import proposes what it is. Shown, not applied
A broken marker: match by heading. Low confidence asks which record
A Mermaid edit: arrows between known nodes become relation proposals
Layout-only changes are ignored

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Review card. Nothing applies without Enter
Impact is shown. Apply both, or discard
One change set, origin markdown_edit. Then the same rules as chat

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Database still at the marker's version?

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Clean apply

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Field-level merge, shown

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Conflict card. You choose. No automatic prose merge
While pending, that file is not overwritten

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: File or section removed?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No record is deleted. Restore is the default
Retire these items is explicit, with impact

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: A proposal to retire that record. Never automatic

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Recognized by ef_file. Content is imported
The view is regenerated at its standard path

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Pending edits affect no agent
An applied edit holds or refreshes only attempts whose read set contains it

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One write connection. WAL so readers do not block
Workers have no database access. MCP and typed proposals only
UI and exporters read a committed revision
A second process is read-only: owner row, BEGIN IMMEDIATE, and a file lock
Option A and hybrid writers were rejected: enforcement would sit in foreign code

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bookkeeping only. Model calls, Git and exports are outside the transaction
Group commit every few milliseconds. One savepoint per request
Heartbeats stay in memory. Token streams are not stored
Bounded queues. Telemetry yields to task transitions
Target: 50 simulated workers, p99 under 50 ms

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: What could go wrong?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Retry the whole transaction

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: One conditional update. Success is exactly one row changed. Epoch increments

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Valid only if the epoch matches at commit
A submission that arrived in time is not expired for queue delay

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Operation ID, persisted before send. A repeat returns the stored receipt
Candidates are also unique by task, attempt and commit
No receipt means not recorded

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Roll back. Safe mode: stop dispatch, keep worktrees and checkpoints

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: data_version changed. Integrity check, then safe mode

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Record version and content hash. Edge-set version. History is immutable
Global revision labels snapshots and exports. It does not decide freshness
A change set stores origin, what it read, old and new versions, and a class
Cosmetic: non-normative prose. Clarifying: consistent detail, owner plus gate
Compatible: structured diff. Breaking: value, removal, or unmarked normative text

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Class, for each dependent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Regenerate the view. Tasks are left alone

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Not started: refresh the brief
Running: a steer at the next boundary
Submitted: verify on current checks
Accepted: re-verify. A new receipt if it still passes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Not started: refresh, and the planner reviews scope
Running: hold, refresh, resume or a fresh session
Submitted: verify on the new checks after the planner updates them
Accepted: re-verify. Rework only if a check fails, or new behavior has no task

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Walk reverse edges, breadth first, bounded
If a regenerated brief or check has the same hash, stop. Early cutoff
Acceptance compares the read set with current versions
A breaking difference cannot be accepted until current checks pass
Optimistic change sets recompute if their read versions moved
Disjoint sets both commit. Same record: the owner, or the developer if both are explicit
Five edits of one contract: one impact run

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Authentication, as specified
A-021 gains Google. Breaking. CS-88, revision 215
Planner publishes C-014 v2, task T-018, and updates the check only if needed
T-014 is re-verified and stays accepted. A running consumer gets a steer
New workers get v2. Unrelated tasks never notice

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tests: 50 workers, no double holder, no lost receipt, no stale epoch
Crash before the receipt: retry writes exactly one row
Edit a view while closed, then change the same record: a conflict, nothing overwritten
Delete the views folder: records stay, files regenerate
An unrelated fact holds zero tasks. A compatible contract change only steers consumers

svg.text: Knowledge database — views, one writer, per-record versions
